### Observed differences

- A01 was not observed in any of the 200 earlier traces; in the later window it is executed exactly once in every trace, near the end of the trace (mean relative position about 0.93, middle half between 0.90 and 1.0). [OCC001, POS001]
- In the earlier window the end of the process was a tight A15→A16→A15 cycle (A15's only observed successor was A16, and A16's only A15). In the later window A15 leads to A01 in about 50% of its outgoing transitions and A16 to A01 in about 51%, while A01 leads back to A16 (about 54%) or A15 (about 46%); A01 co-occurs with A15 and with A16 in every later trace, in both orders in similar proportions (A01 before A15 in 52% of traces, A15 before A01 in 48%; A01 before A16 in 53%, A16 before A01 in 47%). [DIR001, DIR004, DIR005, REL008, REL009]
- A02 appeared in 48% of earlier traces and appears in every later trace, now near the start (mean relative position about 0.02), and its outgoing flow moved from A03 (56%) and A07 (44%) to mainly A06 (90%); A02 now precedes A12 in about 97% of later traces and precedes A15 and A16 in all of them. [OCC002, POS002, DIR002, REL015, REL016, REL017]
- A06, A12 and A11 are executed more often in the later window: A06 about 2.1 times per trace in every trace (earlier about 1.1 times in 52% of traces), A12 in every trace (earlier 52%), A11 in 53% of traces (earlier 26%); A06 now co-occurs in every trace with A05, A03 and A07, mostly interleaved or repeated (about 77–81%). [OCC003, OCC005, OCC004, REL021, REL018, REL024]
- Distances grew: the gap from A02 to A03 and to A07 went from 1–2 steps to 3–5 steps, the gap to A05 is now mostly 5 steps, A03 and A07 sit slightly later (medians 0.39→0.50 and 0.40→0.49), and A15→A16 is 2 steps apart in about 37% of cases (earlier always 1 step). [LAG001, LAG003, LAG002, POS003, POS004, LAG007]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that A01 was added to the process and inserted into the A15/A16 cycle at the end: A01, not observed earlier, is executed once in every later trace near the end; A15 and A16, which previously led only to each other, now each lead to A01 in about half of their outgoing transitions, and A01 leads back into A15 or A16, with A01 co-occurring with both in every trace in both orders. The change is shown directly by participation (0 of 200 to 200 of 200 traces), position, and successor changes on both sides, and 58 evidence items qualified against roughly 0.53 expected by chance for the 107 tested units, so the overall difference count cannot be explained by random re-splits; the many relation items involving A01 describe the same underlying behaviour rather than independent confirmations. [OCC001, POS001, DIR001, DIR004, DIR005, REL008, REL009]

Limitations: absence in the earlier window only means A01 was not observed there, so a re-labelling of an existing activity under an anonymous code cannot be ruled out, and the exact number of times the A15/A16/A01 cycle runs per trace cannot be determined from these indicators. [OCC001, DIR004, DIR005]

Other differences: A02 became mandatory and front-positioned and now routes mainly to A06 instead of A03/A07, with A06 about twice as frequent, A12 now in every trace and A11 about twice as often — a participation and routing change the evidence cannot tie to A01's insertion or separate from it; the larger gaps from A02 to A03/A05/A07 and the slightly later positions of A03/A07 are consistent with more activity between them. [OCC002, POS002, DIR002, OCC003, OCC005, OCC004, REL015, LAG001, LAG003, LAG002, POS003, POS004]
